Subject: SIG timeline and hard deadline for evidence

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Finora's security review board set a hard internal milestone: we need the completed SIG answers and supporting evidence uploaded to our Drive by COB Tuesday 2026-11-30. The reviewers will start validation on Wednesday morning.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you confirm which remaining control responses will require screenshots or logs vs. pointer to docs?
- We need a 60–90 minute cutover window Friday 2026-11-27 to validate our test integration — can Redwood be available?

Appreciate a short matrix of outstanding items and an availability confirmation.

Best,
Alice
Security Program Manager
Finora Inc

Alice — thanks for the clarity and the deadline. We can meet the COB Tue 11/30 target.

Quick status snapshot (will follow with the matrix):
- Screenshots/logs needed: 8 controls (auth, session, key rotation, audit logs) — Kar, Monica to capture.
- Pointer to docs only: 10 controls (policies, training records, data retention).
- Outstanding: one open question on vendor subprocessors where we need to confirm a recent update (Rishi following up).

Regarding the Friday cutover window (11/27): we can support a 90-minute slot 14:00–15:30 PT. Please confirm the exact time and test plan.

I'll attach an evidence matrix by EOD today and include deliver owners.

Thanks,

Team — good work so far. A couple of operational notes from me:
- Monica: prioritize the audit-log snapshots and the admin activity screenshots. Capture multiple timestamped exports to show retention.
- Rishi: push the subprocessors confirmation to Legal and get a signed statement or updated vendor list; we can't leave that as TBD.
- Kar (Karthik): I'll own the upload process to Finora Drive on Tues morning; please tag files with the control IDs (e.g., SIG-03-AUTH).

Also, for the Friday window, confirm on this thread whether Finora prefers 14:00 PT or wants us to shift earlier. If they ask earlier, we can move Monica's slot to 12:30 but confirm now.

Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick responses. Confirming Finora will take the 14:00–15:30 PT slot on Friday 11/27. Our test plan:
- 14:00–14:15: connectivity and auth smoke tests
- 14:15–14:45: ingestion of sample PII-masked payloads and response validation
- 14:45–15:15: review of access logs and session traces (we'll request live exports)
- 15:15–15:30: wrap and immediate follow-up notes

Please ensure audit-log exports are available and that someone from your side can generate the admin activity screenshots during the window.

One more note: we flagged SIG control SIG-12 (data destruction) for more detailed evidence — if you can include the DD policy and one example delete job log that'd be helpful.

Regards,
Alice
